entry.title: Praia da Gale, Albufeira
entry.summary: Praia da Gale is a long beach of golden sand in the Algarve, west of Albufeira, backed by low sandy cliffs and with calm water. It is a popular family beach with restaurants behind and a walkway along the shore.

entry.title: Praia de Moledo
entry.summary: Praia de Moledo is a long beach of fine sand in the north of Portugal, near Caminha, with pine woods behind and the Minho river and the Spanish coast in view. The Atlantic water is cool, and the beach is popular with families and surfers.

entry.title: Praia da Amoreira, Aljezur
entry.summary: Praia da Amoreira is a wide beach on the Costa Vicentina near Aljezur, where a river and a lagoon meet the Atlantic below low cliffs. At low tide the sand opens up into a long shore, and the waves attract surfers and bodyboarders.

entry.title: Praia do Rostro, Fisterra
entry.summary: Praia do Rostro is a long beach of fine pale sand on the Costa da Morte in Galicia, near Fisterra and Cee, with a small lagoon behind and mountains on each side. The Atlantic waves are strong and the water is cool.

entry.title: Playa de Xago
entry.summary: Playa de Xago is a wide beach of golden sand in Asturias, near Cabo Penas, with dunes behind and strong Atlantic waves that attract surfers. The beach sits on a coast of cliffs and green headlands.

entry.title: Playazo de Rodalquilar
entry.summary: El Playazo is a long beach of sand and fine gravel near Rodalquilar, in the Cabo de Gata-Nijar natural park in Almeria, with the ruined Castillo de San Ramon at the north end. Hills of red and brown volcanic rock rise behind the shore.

entry.title: Playa de Benijo, Tenerife
entry.summary: Playa de Benijo is a beach of dark sand and rocks below the Anaga mountains on the north-east coast of Tenerife, with sea stacks called the Roques de Anaga rising from the water. The Atlantic waves are strong, so most visitors come for the views and sunset.

entry.title: Baia del Buondormire, Palinuro
entry.summary: Baia del Buondormire is a small bay of clear turquoise water on Capo Palinuro, in the Cilento coast of Campania, enclosed by tall cliffs and rocks. Boat trips from Palinuro also visit the sea caves along the cape.

entry.title: Porto Ferro Beach
entry.summary: Porto Ferro is a beach of golden sand on the north-west coast of Sardinia, north of Alghero, set between low cliffs with an old watchtower on the headland above. The waves attract surfers when the wind blows from the north-west.

entry.title: Citara Beach, Ischia
entry.summary: Citara is a long beach of dark volcanic sand on the west coast of Ischia, near Forio, known for the thermal baths of the Poseidon gardens and for sunsets over the sea. The beach is lively in summer and the water drops away quickly.

entry.title: Tolo Beach, Peloponnese
entry.summary: Tolo is a resort village on the east coast of the Peloponnese near Nafplio, with a long beach of pale sand curving around a sheltered bay. The water is shallow and calm, and small islands lie offshore.

entry.title: Skala Potamia Beach, Thasos
entry.summary: Skala Potamia is a small harbour village on the east coast of Thasos with a long beach of sand and fine pebbles beside the harbour. Tavernas line the seafront, and the water is clear and shallow near the shore.

entry.title: Roukounas Beach, Anafi
entry.summary: Roukounas is one of the main beaches of Anafi, a small island east of Santorini, with a long curve of sand below a rocky headland and clear water. The island has few visitors, and the beach is reached on foot or by road from the main village.

entry.title: Xi Beach, Kefalonia
entry.summary: Xi Beach is a long stretch of reddish-gold sand on the Paliki peninsula of Kefalonia, south of Lixouri, backed by low clay cliffs. The sea is shallow and calm, and many visitors rub the soft clay from the cliffs on their skin.

entry.title: Plage du Canadel
entry.summary: Plage du Canadel is a beach of sand and pebbles at Le Rayol-Canadel-sur-Mer on the Var coast, between Cavalaire and Le Lavandou, with green hills behind and clear water. The Domaine du Rayol, a Mediterranean garden, lies close by.

entry.title: Ostriconi Beach
entry.summary: Ostriconi is a wide sandy beach on the edge of the Desert des Agriates in north-west Corsica, where a small river meets the sea behind the dunes. The water is clear and shallow, and the coast on both sides is wild and undeveloped.

entry.title: Nonza Beach
entry.summary: Nonza beach is a long beach of dark grey pebbles at the foot of the Corsican village of Nonza, on the west side of Cap Corse. The village sits on a cliff above with an old tower, and the sea below is clear and deep close to the shore.

entry.title: Baie des Trepasses
entry.summary: The Baie des Trepasses is a wide bay of pale sand at the western end of the Cap Sizun peninsula in Brittany, close to the Pointe du Raz. Atlantic waves roll in between rocky headlands, and currents can be strong.

entry.title: Plage du Dossen
entry.summary: Plage du Dossen is a wide beach of fine pale sand and dunes near Santec on the north coast of Finistere in Brittany. At low tide the sand stretches out a long way, and the beach looks out towards Roscoff and the Ile de Batz.

entry.title: Plage de Cabasson
entry.summary: Plage de Cabasson is a small beach of sand and fine pebbles below the Fort de Bregancon, on the Var coast near Bormes-les-Mimosas. The bay is sheltered, the water is clear and pines grow close to the shore.

entry.title: Argeles-Plage
entry.summary: Argeles-Plage is a long beach of fine sand on the Vermilion Coast in the south of France, close to the Spanish border, with the Albera mountains in view behind. The sea is shallow and the shore is lined with campsites, cafes and a seafront promenade.

entry.title: Donje Celo Beach, Kolocep
entry.summary: Donje Celo is a small village on Kolocep, the smallest inhabited Elaphiti island near Dubrovnik, with a small sandy beach in a sheltered bay. There are no cars on the island, and boats from Dubrovnik make the crossing a short ride.

entry.title: Njivice Beach, Krk
entry.summary: Njivice is a pebble beach in a sheltered bay on the northern side of Krk island, with pine trees behind and a long seafront promenade. The water is shallow and clear, which suits families with children.

entry.title: Tucepi Beach
entry.summary: Tucepi is a long pebble beach on the Makarska Riviera in central Dalmatia, below the Biokovo mountains. The water is clear, pines and palms line the seafront, and there are bars, restaurants and water sports along the shore.

entry.title: Plage du Verger, Cancale
entry.summary: Plage du Verger is a wide beach of fine sand at Cancale in Brittany, on the shore of the Bay of Mont-Saint-Michel. The sea goes out far at low tide and returns quickly, so timing matters.

entry.title: Plage de Coz Pors, Tregastel
entry.summary: Plage de Coz Pors is a sheltered sandy beach in Tregastel on the Pink Granite Coast of Brittany, with rounded pink rocks, small islands offshore and clear water. At low tide the sand spreads out, and at high tide the beach becomes small.

entry.title: Espiguette Beach, Le Grau-du-Roi
entry.summary: Espiguette is a wide, wild beach of fine sand at the southern tip of the Camargue near Le Grau-du-Roi, with dunes, a lighthouse and a very long shoreline. Parts of it are protected, and the sea is shallow and gentle with a long sandbar.

entry.title: Plage Saint-Francoise, Ajaccio
entry.summary: Plage Saint-Francoise is a small town beach in Ajaccio, Corsica, a strip of sand and pebbles with clear blue water and mountains rising behind the bay. The old citadel is close, and the centre of town is a short walk away.

entry.title: Plage de Morgat, Crozon
entry.summary: Morgat is a seaside village on the Crozon peninsula in Brittany, with a wide sheltered beach of fine sand, a harbour and a promenade of old seafront houses. The bay is calm, and boats leave from the harbour for the sea caves along the coast.

entry.title: Praia do Tamariz, Estoril
entry.summary: Praia do Tamariz is the main beach of Estoril on the Lisbon coast, a curve of golden sand sheltered by a breakwater, with the casino gardens and a seafront promenade behind. The water is calmer than at most Atlantic beaches, and the train from Lisbon stops nearby.
